verification.scope: Nine full terminal and agent palettes: original controller hashes, fresh original/current layouts, exact same-instance native CSS-delta roundtrips at two widths, themes and motion settings, plus fresh offline full exports. verification.surfaceMethod: Nominal CSS foreground against conservative RGB244 light Stage, RGB21 dark Stage, or the documented opaque panel surfaces in the fixture. Does not certify every transition-opacity blend.
verification.capture: Chrome is launched with --disable-gpu for this CSS pixel comparison. Direct CDP capture follows two global frames while source runtime remains held. One priming readback is retained separately before the native baseline. Native checks apply and remove the exact CSS suffix on one initialized instance, preserving its clock, DOM, computed styles and pixels. Priming and separate-startup images remain recorded. Default GPU readback variance is retained separately and is not certified by this comparison.
verification.geometryPose: Full geometry uses explicit DOM animation time0 while source time is held. Prior animation states remain in every full-layout row. Native CSS roundtrips retain their actual held source state and do not use this full-pose normalization.
